verdict.rationale: Antigravity's own product page documents Scheduled Tasks: you define a cron schedule and agents then start and run autonomously in the background. That is a genuine recurring schedule, not a one-off action. A separate feature for scheduling messages to agents while away adds support, while headless CLI/CI scripting is adjacent and not credited. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on configuring and managing scheduled tasks (run history, failure handling, limits), and independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled tasks work as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Automate routine checks with Scheduled Tasks, simply define a cron schedule and the agents start and run autonomously in the background.
users can schedule messages to be sent to their agents while they’re away
